name: Driving Base 1
note: FIRST robot guide: drive C (left) + D (right), accessory motor E

name: Driving Base 2
note: FIRST robot guide: drive C (left) + D (right), accessory motor E; takes its arm, force sensor (A) and distance sensor (F) accessories

name: Driving Base 3
note: FIRST robot guide: drive C (left) + D (right), accessory motor E, colour sensor B

name: Advanced Driving Base
note: FIRST robot guide: drive A (left) + E (right, large motors), tool motors C (rear) and D (front), colour sensors B and F; takes the dozer blade (rear) and lift arm (front)
